fools_crumb.shortDefinition: Large isolated caverns surrounded by dense, tight crumb. Usually indicates under-fermentation or weak starter.

gummy_crumb.shortDefinition: A dense, rubbery layer at the base of the loaf.

dense_crumb.shortDefinition: Lack of porosity and aeration throughout the loaf.

over_fermentation.shortDefinition: Excessive fermentation leading to gluten breakdown and sugar depletion.

under_fermentation.shortDefinition: Insufficient fermentation resulting in poor gas distribution and dense crumb.

autolyse.shortDefinition: Resting flour and water to activate enzymes and develop gluten before mixing.
